findings.statement: CA9 is up in tumor at RNA (log2FC 6.312) and protein (log2FC 2.269), replicates in TCGA-KIRC (log2FC 9.712) and stays high extrapolated to purity 1 (RNA log2FC 7.787), so it is tumor-cell intrinsic. Cis copy-number rho is 0.224 and the antibody girentuximab has reached PHASE_3.

SCARB1 is the top-ranked target: RNA log2FC 2.974 and protein log2FC 1.837, TCGA-KIRC log2FC 3.989, and a purity-1 RNA log2FC of 3.762 (SE 0.408), so the signal comes from tumor cells. TCGA Cox log HR is -0.038, so it is not prognostic.

CD70 is up in tumor at RNA (log2FC 4.464) and protein (log2FC 2.421) and replicates in TCGA-KIRC (log2FC 7.09). It is an immunotherapy-tractable surface antigen, and clinical-stage anti-CD70 agents include cusatuzumab (PHASE_2) and vorsetuzumab mafodotin (PHASE_1).
ENPP3 is a membrane enzyme up in tumor at RNA (log2FC 3.895) and protein (log2FC 1.544), with TCGA-KIRC log2FC 5.557. Its cnv_loss_freq is 0.182, and the ADC AGS-16C3F has reached PHASE_2.

NNMT is up at RNA (log2FC 4.67) and protein (log2FC 2.709) and replicates in TCGA-KIRC (log2FC 4.685). Higher expression is associated with worse survival (Cox log HR 0.301, padj 0.00479). It ranks 4th for target and 6th for biomarker.

SLC16A3 (MCT4, a lactate transporter) is up at RNA (log2FC 3.435) and protein (log2FC 2.279), with TCGA-KIRC log2FC 3.291 and a purity-1 RNA log2FC of 3.821. Ranked 3rd for target, with a Warburg-type metabolic rationale.
FABP6 is up at RNA (log2FC 4.006) and protein (log2FC 1.921), with TCGA-KIRC log2FC 6.431. Its cnv_gain_freq is 0.573 and cis rho is 0.309, so there is a genuine copy-number gain dosage effect.

CYP2J2 is up at RNA (log2FC 3.849) and protein (log2FC 1.863), with TCGA-KIRC log2FC 5.025. Higher expression is favorable (Cox log HR -0.195, padj 0.0065). It is an up-regulated biomarker with a purity-1 RNA log2FC of 4.151.

PSAT1 is the top biomarker. It is down in tumor at RNA (log2FC -3.867) and protein (log2FC -1.963), replicates in TCGA-KIRC (log2FC -2.974), and low expression predicts worse survival (Cox log HR 0.43, padj 5.66e-7).

PCK1 (gluconeogenesis) is down in tumor at RNA (log2FC -4.424) and protein (log2FC -1.859) and replicates in TCGA-KIRC (log2FC -3.079). Higher expression is protective (Cox log HR -0.415), consistent with loss of proximal tubule identity.

ALDH6A1 is down at RNA (log2FC -3.399) and protein (log2FC -1.925), with TCGA-KIRC log2FC -2.805. It has cnv_loss_freq 0.355 and cis rho 0.525, so 3p-type copy loss is a real dosage effect, and loss predicts worse survival (Cox log HR -0.554 for higher expression).

SLC6A19, a proximal-tubule amino acid transporter, is down at RNA (log2FC -4.574) and protein (log2FC -1.48). TCGA-KIRC log2FC is -3.221, and higher expression is favorable (Cox log HR -0.456). This is a tubule-identity loss marker, not a target.
PPP1R1A is down at RNA (log2FC -2.974) and protein (log2FC -1.139), with TCGA-KIRC log2FC -5.179. Low expression predicts worse survival (Cox log HR 0.403, padj 0.00000155).

HK2 (glycolysis) is up at RNA (log2FC 3.351) and protein (log2FC 2.106), with TCGA-KIRC log2FC 3.974. It is a metabolic target candidate, but the DepMap mean effect in ccRCC is -0.123, so dependency is weak.

caveats: Values come from the convergence_ranking rows (all profiles) and their evidence records. I ran no additional per-gene queries for RNA-protein correlation, phosphosites or kinase activity.
DepMap shows no strong selective dependency for the top up-regulated genes. Target prioritization rests on expression, tumor-intrinsic signal and tractability, not on functional essentiality.
Down-regulated biomarkers mostly reflect loss of proximal tubule identity and are not therapeutic targets. Bulk tumor-versus-normal contrasts can be influenced by cell composition.
Mutation recurrence for the top candidates is low, so none is a driver. VHL/PBRM1/SETD2/BAP1 mechanism genes were not queried here.
